text:
sophie: hi team, first day in design! quick blockers: 1) my Figma org invite arrived but i can't open the squad component library (Request access) 2) where's the live product roadmap for my new squad (Search didn't find it) 3) who do i talk to about booking the user lab and incentive budget? also, do we have a filename pattern for prototypes?
alan: welcome sophie :wave: Figma library is team-restricted. what's the email you used for SSO? i'll add you to the `design:ux` group.
sophie: sophie.p@redwood.ai
alan: added you. refresh Figma and enable Libraries in the sidebar. if it still shows Request Access, tell me and i'll escalate.
design-ops-bot: Quick fix: sign-in via https://auth.redwood.com/sso then retry. To request edit perms for design system files, run `/access request design-system` and include your github handle.
pm-claire: roadmap lives in Notion under Product -> Roadmaps -> "Wave Squad". link: https://notion.so/redwood/wave-roadmap. PMs have edit; designers typically comment then request edit if needed.
sophie: found it, thanks! small process q on prototypes: i've seen names like `wave_onboard_v1` and `proto/wave-onboard-v1`. which should i use?
ux-ops: canonical pattern is `proto/<team>-<feature>-v1` (kebab-case) and we start filenames with `proto/` so our indexer picks them up. example: `proto/wave-onboard-v1`.
alan: also, discovery notes should go into Notion -> Research -> Discovery Notes -> Wave so they are searchable and linkable to roadmap items.
sophie: perfect. last ask: booking user lab and incentives?
pm-claire: post dates + cohort size in #research-scheduling and tag @research-ops; for physical lab put event on the Research Calendar. budget requests go through research-ops and they will confirm compensation rates.
sophie: all set 10: can open DS library and roadmap, booked a 30m sync with PM. thanks for the speedy help :tada:
